mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which negatively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the combination signals a potential overheating economy with loose monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand for new homes, indicating broader economic weakness and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% QoQ and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO is declining, and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.
